implementation_basis: Existing authored fixed perfusion inputs, not clinical calibration
invariants: Independent atrial and ventricular source grids shared with12-lead ECG
No clipping of pulse supports; finite pressure and optical runoff history
CVP superposition preserves atrioventricular phase drift without artificial a-wave amplification
Default Resp/CO2 unchanged; cardiac artifact uses ventricular events
Atomic conflicts, reset/clear, stale timer fencing and wire recovery in physiology demo
limitations: Fixed ejection strength, not AIVR stroke volume or pressure calibration
No cannon a, valve mechanics or phase-dependent pump feedback
Gradual onset/termination, AIVR capture/fusion and other autonomous rhythms remain open
